tests.name: Invalid NFInstanceId
tests.constraint: The path parameter must be a valid NfInstanceId.

tests.name: Missing NFProfile Body
tests.constraint: The request body is required and must be sent as 'application/json' containing an NFProfile object (schema reference '#/components/schemas/NFProfile').

tests.name: NFProfile Not Object
tests.constraint: The NFProfile object MUST be of type object.

tests.name: Missing nfStatus in NFProfile
tests.constraint: The NFProfile object MUST contain the properties 'nfInstanceId', 'nfType', and 'nfStatus'.

tests.name: Missing network identifiers (no fqdn or IP addresses)
tests.constraint: The NFProfile object MUST contain at least one of the following properties: 'fqdn', 'ipv4Addresses', or 'ipv6Addresses' (anyOf constraint).

tests.name: Empty collocatedNfInstances array
tests.constraint: If present, 'collocatedNfInstances' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to the CollocatedNfInstance schema.

tests.name: Invalid heartBeatTimer below minimum
tests.constraint: If present, 'heartBeatTimer' must be an integer with a minimum value of 1.

tests.name: Invalid plmnList - empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'plmnList' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/PlmnId.

tests.name: Invalid empty snpnList
tests.constraint: If present, 'snpnList' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to PlmnIdNid.

tests.name: Invalid sNssais Empty Array
tests.constraint: If present, 'sNssais' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/ExtSnssai.

tests.name: Invalid perPlmnSnssaiList - empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'perPlmnSnssaiList' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/PlmnSnssai'.

tests.name: Invalid nsiList - empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'nsiList' must be an array of strings with at least 1 item.

tests.name: Invalid ipv4Addresses - empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'ipv4Addresses' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/Ipv4Addr.

tests.name: Invalid empty ipv6Addresses
tests.constraint: If present, 'ipv6Addresses' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/Ipv6Addr.

tests.name: Invalid allowedPlmns empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'allowedPlmns' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to PlmnId.

tests.name: Invalid empty allowedSnpns
tests.constraint: If present, 'allowedSnpns' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/PlmnIdNid.

tests.name: Invalid allowedNfTypes - empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'allowedNfTypes' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/NFType'.

tests.name: Invalid allowedNfDomains empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'allowedNfDomains' must be an array of strings with at least 1 item.

tests.name: Invalid allowedNssais - empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'allowedNssais' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/ExtSnssai.

tests.name: Empty allowedRuleSet
tests.constraint: If present, 'allowedRuleSet' must be an object with at least 1 property and each property value must conform to the RuleSet schema; an empty object violates this constraint.

tests.name: Invalid Priority Too High
tests.constraint: If present, 'priority' must be an integer between 0 and 65535 inclusive.

tests.name: Invalid capacity too large
tests.constraint: If present, 'capacity' must be an integer between 0 and 65535 inclusive.

tests.name: Invalid load above allowed maximum
tests.constraint: If present, 'load' must be an integer between 0 and 100 inclusive.

tests.name: Invalid extLocality - empty object
tests.constraint: If present, 'extLocality' must be an object with string values and at least 1 property when present.

tests.name: Invalid empty udrInfoList
tests.constraint: When present, udrInfoList must be an object with at least one property (minProperties: 1).

tests.name: Invalid nfServices Empty Array
tests.constraint: If present, 'nfServices' (deprecated) must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/NFService'.

tests.name: Invalid empty defaultNotificationSubscriptions
tests.constraint: If present, 'defaultNotificationSubscriptions' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/DefaultNotificationSubscription'.

tests.name: Invalid nfSetIdList Empty Array
tests.constraint: If present, 'nfSetIdList' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/NfSetId.

tests.name: Invalid servingScope: empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'servingScope' must be an array of strings with at least 1 item.

tests.name: Empty nfSetRecoveryTimeList
tests.constraint: If present, 'nfSetRecoveryTimeList' and 'serviceSetRecoveryTimeList' must be objects with at least one property and values conforming to DateTime.

tests.name: Invalid scpDomains - empty array
tests.constraint: If present, 'scpDomains' must be an array of strings with at least 1 item.

tests.name: Invalid supportedVendorSpecificFeatures value (empty array)
tests.constraint: If present, 'supportedVendorSpecificFeatures' must be an object with at least 1 property; each value must be an array with at least 1 VendorSpecificFeature item.

tests.name: Invalid empty hniList
tests.constraint: If present, 'hniList' must be an array with at least 1 FQDN item.

tests.name: Invalid sharedProfileDataId format
tests.constraint: If present, 'sharedProfileDataId' must be a UUID-formatted string.

tests.name: Invalid shutdownTime format
tests.constraint: If present, 'shutdownTime' must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/DateTime.

tests.name: Invalid supportedRcfs Empty Array
tests.constraint: If present, 'supportedRcfs' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/RcfId'.

tests.name: Invalid ipv4Addresses item
tests.constraint: Nested component properties must satisfy their referenced-schema constraints. The ipv4Addresses entry violates the Ipv4Addr schema by containing an invalid IPv4 address.
